density.staffTables: compact without smaller text or inaccessible controls

Give icon-only controls an accessible name and a larger interaction area

Adjacent interaction areas must not overlap

controls.growth: Controls grow for wrapped labels or larger text

bordersAndFocus.stateRule: Invalid and selected controls include an icon, label, or state marker alongside color
bordersAndFocus.spacingScope: The 2px base governs spacing, not every stroke thickness

elevation.darkModeRule: Raised surface colors and clear borders provide the main separation

rules: Grids guide alignment; forms and tables may span multiple columns

rules: Animation never delays interaction or confirmed results
motion.easing: Named registry: linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, emphasized

rules: Arabic interface quantities also use international digits
